meta.title: LRRMtG - 4 Player Magic: the Gathering Commander
meta.game_window: Game runs ~11:34 to ~1:41:49; before is intro/sponsor, after is post-game discussion + housekeeping

eliminations.cause: Damage - Ben sacrifices Thopters/Wellspring to Breya-stolen(?) effect... (see key_events; Serge at 3 life, finished with 6 damage)
Empty library - attempts to draw with no cards left after Phenax mill (loses to draw from empty library)

meta.extraction_method: YouTube auto-generated captions (ASR, no speaker labels, 2017-era ASR is noisier). Condensed key-event log; full raw transcript not stored due to 2h length - timestamps allow re-extraction of any segment.
meta.note: This game is COMPLETE (has a winner), making it the best end-to-end training sample so far. It also features an experienced judge-adjacent player (Serge) giving many rules explanations.

players.name: Ben Ulmer
players.deck: Mill homebrew ('mill equals booty') - walls + Phenax tap-to-mill

key_events.detail: d20-style roll-off; Kathleen wins and goes first
'This is commander so you draw on your first turn' - CORRECT for multiplayer

key_events.card: Curse of Vengeance (on... actually cast by KATHLEEN? Speaker says never played the deck before - this is Kathleen? No: 11:43 Kathleen plays swamp+go; 11:52 next player (Serge) casts Curse of Vengeance choosing Serge...
key_events.detail: ATTRIBUTION AMBIGUOUS: someone enchants a player with Curse of Vengeance (spite counters per spell cast; when cursed player loses, caster draws/gains life per counter). Rolled a die to pick target: Serge got cursed
Blood Seeker 1/1: whenever a creature enters under an opponent's control, that player may lose 1 life
Fetches Sol Ring from library (searches for artifact MV<=1)
Shroud + haste equipment; equip 0. Hexproof-vs-shroud debate: 'I dislike hexproof more than shroud' - table understands shroud symmetric, hexproof one-sided
Mana rock; {7},{T}, sac: destroy target permanent
Artifact spells cost {1} less
Serge casts Sol Ring (free via Sculptor discount); Ben counters it. Spite counter added (Curse of Vengeance tracking casts)
Pays 1, equips Lightning Greaves (hexproof-and-haste line as heard - actually shroud)
Defensive walls (big toughness for Phenax mill)

COMPLEX RESOLUTION: choose a nonland permanent you don't control; each other player chooses a nonland permanent they don't control that hasn't been chosen; destroy all other nonland permanents. Table walks through the choose-order carefully (caster first, then each other player), notes it does NOT target. Deals/politics over what survives (24:33-27:13)
key_events.validation: CORRECT - non-targeting 'choose' handled properly, APNAP-style choice order

key_events.detail: Living weapon: enters attached to a 0/0 Germ token; +X/+X = creatures in ALL graveyards. Table confirms it counts all graveyards (37:02)
Devotion to U/B is 4 (<7), so Phenax is NOT a creature - just an indestructible enchantment providing the mill ability. Table handles the Theros god devotion mechanic correctly

Discussion of who to enchant; gold token generation on attacks. 32:58 'I should have lost a life when my Germ came into play - no wait, living weapon token isn't a cast creature spell... actually Blood Seeker triggers on ENTER not cast' - they self-correct: token entering DOES trigger Blood Seeker
key_events.validation: FLAG - they concluded the Germ token doesn't trigger Blood Seeker ('if it was cast a creature spell it would be different'), but Blood Seeker triggers on a creature ENTERING, and a Germ token entering under an opponent's control should trigger it. MISSED TRIGGER (minor)

key_events.card: Miri? 'Miri the cursed' = Mirri the Cursed
key_events.detail: Flying, first strike, haste vampire cat; +1/+1 counter when she deals combat damage to a creature
ETB/attack: attach any number of target Equipment to it - including OPPONENTS' equipment (confirmed at 39:01)

key_events.card: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth ('an herb org - swamps for everybody')
key_events.detail: All lands are Swamps in addition to their types

key_events.card: Dragon's Eye Savants (morph face-up?) + Wight of Precinct Six
key_events.detail: Wight gets +1/+1 per creature in OPPONENTS' graveyards only - table correctly distinguishes from Bonehoard's all-graveyards count (38:13-38:23)

key_events.card: Ramos, Dragon Engine (8 mana? '8 mana six' - 6 generic cast)
key_events.detail: Whenever you cast a spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Ramos for each of that spell's colors; remove five counters: add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}{G}... (WUBRG x2)

All creatures -3/-3 until end of turn; then cast a spell MV<=3 free (casts Crypt Incursion on Ben: exile all creature cards from his graveyard, gain 3 per card - gains 12). Ben responds by tapping Phenax creatures to mill in response (601.3/priority). Wight survives momentarily due to graveyard growth question -> resolved via state-based actions

STATE-BASED ACTIONS explained precisely: everything gets -3/-3, SBAs are checked, Wight dies simultaneously with everything else - it can't 'grow back' from the deaths because power boost and deaths are evaluated at the same SBA check. Serge: 'state based actions are checked, that kills the Wight, everything dies, and then state-based check again.'
key_events.validation: CORRECT - textbook SBA explanation, great training sample

key_events.detail: Phenax wasn't a creature during the -3/-3 (devotion <7) and is indestructible anyway - unaffected by the wipe

Ramos online; casting dragons pumps him fast (5 colors = +5 per multicolor spell). Casts O-Kagachi? ('okok Arashi' - likely O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami or Crosis?) 48:10: 'whenever it deals damage to a player, if that player attacked you last turn, exile target nonland permanent they control'

Attacks Kathleen for 9 with Ramos - commander damage explicitly tracked on overlay ('you will see the relationship of commander damage in the little color grid'); table notes 21 is the threshold ('Stamos who's got its 21 commander damage? yes')
key_events.validation: CORRECT - 21 threshold correctly cited (contrast game_001 which said 20)

key_events.detail: Names dragon; {1}: becomes copy of target creature of that type until EOT. Serge (judge role) reminds: LEGENDARY RULE applies if copying a legend, and the copy would NOT include +1/+1 counters - 'it would enter as the base copy'
key_events.validation: CORRECT - copy effects don't copy counters; legend rule warning

key_events.card: Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet ('Calot eyes trailer... good old cleetus')
key_events.detail: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead and create a 2/2 Zombie; {2}{B}, sac another Vampire/Zombie: two +1/+1 counters
Cast an instant/sorcery from an opponent's graveyard: picks Ian's... casts (from Ian's yard) - deal-making about Fortunate Few style choices follows

Board wipe #3 (Disk or wipe): 'Phenax is indestructible and the wording is destroy' - Phenax survives. Kalitas replacement: every opponent creature that would die is EXILED instead, Kathleen gets zombies. Germ token under the 'chosen to keep' deal survives. Multi-layer interaction handled correctly including Kalitas + tokens (tokens that die don't give zombies? they exile nontoken only - table checks wording)
'Commanders don't get exiled, they just go back to the command zone' - the optional replacement applied on exile too
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, +1/+1 counter and gain 1 life
Exiles Serge's zombie(?) - instant-speed removal

key_events.card: Avatar of Woe adjudicator? + Boros Garrison
key_events.detail: ASR garbled; 'strictly worse avatar of woe' joke; returns Plains via Garrison bounce
Enters with X +1/+1 counters, X = instants+sorceries in ALL graveyards (9); can remove counter to loot
Exile Kathleen's Avatar of Woe; EACH OTHER PLAYER creates a token copy - everyone (but Kathleen) gets an Avatar of Woe. Sets up the late-game 'avatar standoff'
Attacks Kathleen in the air for 12 with Ramos+dragon; Ramos had already dealt 9 commander damage -> exactly 21 commander damage. KATHLEEN ELIMINATED. '21 commander damage. Oh Jesus Christ.'
key_events.validation: CORRECT - first on-camera commander-damage kill in the dataset

key_events.detail: Does Ben's token COPY of Avatar of Woe contribute to devotion? Table reasons: a copy has the copied card's mana cost (it's 'a copy of everything - it has every attribute'), so B/B counts toward devotion; a token that's NOT a copy would have no mana cost. Phenax devotion recount follows
Hits Ben for 9 (Ben to ~13?)
Draws 2, loses 2; Curse-of-Vengeance-style and Sunscorch Regent triggers fire on opponents' casts
Kathleen stays as color commentary; Unseen Academical joke role 'advise them on the game, make a snarky comment'
Removes 5 counters from Ramos -> WUBRG+; casts Ryusei? 'Ryu say the falling star' = Ryusei, the Falling Star

In response to Ian's 9-power air attacks: both tap Avatar of Woe to DESTROY Ian's attacking dragons (Avatar: {T}: destroy target creature, can't be regenerated) - removal in response to attack declaration, attackers removed from combat
key_events.validation: CORRECT - creatures removed from combat deal no damage

key_events.card: Hero's Downfall on Serge's Etherium Sculptor?('either sworn educator')+ Undercity Informer
key_events.detail: Undercity Informer: sac a creature: target player mills until revealing a land
Takes 5 commander damage - 'I hear that's a bad number to get to' (tracking toward 21)
Spellbomb/relic effect: exiles Serge's graveyard, pays black, draws
End-step mill for 10 on Ian (Phenax + big-toughness walls). Ben's strategy: mill at end of turn to play around removal

In response to Serge's play: sacrifices Thopters + Fellwar Stone + Wellspring to Breya-style ability? No - BEN uses stolen(?)/his own sac outlets... As heard: 'I sacrifice my two Thopters and Fellwar Stone and the Wellspring, deal six damage to him straightaway' - SERGE ELIMINATED at 3 life. (Serge had Breya - it may be Serge's own Breya ability used by... attribution uncertain; the eliminator appears to be Ben using Breya's ability after stealing? Flag for review)

key_events.card: Artisan (Sharding Sphinx? 'this artisan') - creates token copies when nontoken creatures enter

key_events.detail: 'Mill you for a bajillion' - taps Academy Elite + walls; Ian mills 5, then 9, then 12, then 19... Ben announces the race explicitly: 'this is definitely a race' (Ian's damage vs Ben's mill)

Complex final stack: Ben's Mortis Dogs?/sacrifice chains, -2/-2 on Phenax from sacrificing artifacts ('sacrifice two artifacts... give Phenax -4/-4'?), responses clarified - 'you do everything in response' teaching moment about holding priority and ordering (1:42:13 postmortem: 'I forgot you do everything in response and I should have been slower')
'I'm gonna draw ten... thanks for the game' - Ian must draw with empty library and LOSES. BEN WINS
key_events.validation: CORRECT - drawing from an empty library is a loss (state-based action)
